meaning:
1) requital, reward
1a) requital, retribution
1b) reward, bribe

elsewhere.note: For Yahweh has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
The days of visitation have come. The days of reckoning have come. Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool, and the man who is inspired to be insane…
Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe; and the powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus…
